lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements comes before the full council — in a box canyon that knows exactly what fire country means, that's not a routine item. Council will also hold a second work session on the Telluride Energy Mitigation program, and the Housing Authority meets the same day to appoint members to its new Resident Advisory Committee, drawing from fifteen tenant applications across Town properties.

notable.stake: First reading of wildfire resilience building-code changes affects how all structures are built here.
THA appoints first-ever Resident Advisory Committee members from Town rental properties.
